items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: And when I got sick Happy Cauldwell took my place on some of them.

ctx.x: Well, he stayed, he was on it, he was on it before me, because it was Cy St. Clair that brought Ben Whitted in. And when I got sick Happy Cauldwell took my place on some of them. See, so that was the names that you must have. You don't have those names - if you don't have Cy St. Clair, then I wasn't on it at all. Or something wrong with the, you know. See, 'cause that's who recommend me, you know. Say, I didn't make nothing without him bein' there because everybody was saying how great he was, he was a great bass…

He brought in Ben Whitted and he brought in me, see? But he didn't - I don't know what Charlie Irvis, I don't know what Charlie Irvis did any, maybe there. Because I think we had Cuffey, I remember Cuffey real well. Another guy that was there often that you must check on, the cousin of Joe Oliver, and he did the arrangement -

items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: And he was in Jutland, so he sent word for me to come out there

ctx.x: Copenhagen because he came in (unintelligible), which is down on the other side, which is part of Copenhagen, in Denmark anyway. And Buddy Tate was there at the same time, and Bud and I could not run across (unintelligible) because when I was in Sweden Bud was back in Copenhagen. And then the promoter's girlfriend and his mother were born in Jutland (unintelligible). So when she came back one time for the weekend and her girlfriend and some of her relatives, (unintelligible) says, well, we saw Benny Waters…

And he was in Jutland, so he sent word for me to come out there, but I was almost on the closing end of this concert thing, and we were going to Norway, and we went to Sweden and back there and we back there for some taping.
Well, what year -- you must get this on there. What year was it that you went to Denmark? Last year?
